description: Read Wikipedia articles, search, sections, categories, links, languages, revisions and diffs, recent changes, page views and featured content, and your own account or a user's contributions on *.wikipedia.org in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Wikipedia session where authentication is required.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Wikipedia articles by keyword. Returns matching articles with snippets, word counts, and timestamps. Supports pagination via offset.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get a Wikipedia article summary including the introduction extract, description, thumbnail, protection status, and URL. Use get_article_sections for the full table of contents, or get_section_content to read a specific section.

tools.name: get_page_summary
tools.description: Get a concise summary of a Wikipedia article using the Wikimedia REST API. Returns a clean extract, description, thumbnail, original image, and desktop/mobile URLs. Lighter than get_article.

tools.name: get_article_sections
tools.description: Get the table of contents (section headings) of a Wikipedia article. Returns section index, heading level, heading text, and anchor. Use the section index with get_section_content to read individual sections.

tools.name: get_section_content
tools.description: Get the plain text content of a specific section of a Wikipedia article. Use get_article_sections first to find section indexes. Section 0 returns the article introduction.

tools.name: get_article_categories
tools.description: Get the categories that a Wikipedia article belongs to. Returns category titles. Supports pagination via continue token.

tools.name: get_article_links
tools.description: Get the internal Wikipedia links from an article. Returns titles of all linked articles. Useful for exploring related topics.

tools.name: get_article_languages
tools.description: Get the list of languages an article is available in. Returns language codes, article titles in each language, and URLs.

tools.name: get_backlinks
tools.description: Get the pages that link to a specific Wikipedia article (also known as "What links here"). Useful for understanding how widely referenced an article is.

tools.name: get_revisions
tools.description: Get the edit history (revisions) of a Wikipedia article. Returns revision IDs, editors, timestamps, edit summaries, and page sizes. Ordered from newest to oldest.

tools.name: compare_revisions
tools.description: Compare two revisions of a Wikipedia article to see what changed. Returns a text diff showing additions and deletions. Provide two revision IDs from get_revisions.

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Get recent edits made across Wikipedia. Returns article titles, editors, timestamps, edit summaries, and size changes. Filtered to article namespace (main content) edits only.

tools.name: get_random_articles
tools.description: Get random Wikipedia articles. Returns article IDs and titles. Useful for discovering content or selecting a random topic.

tools.name: opensearch
tools.description: Autocomplete search for Wikipedia article titles. Returns matching titles and their URLs. Faster and lighter than search_articles — use this for title suggestions and quick lookups.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently logged-in Wikipedia user including username, edit count, registration date, and user groups.

tools.name: get_user_contributions
tools.description: Get recent edits made by a Wikipedia user. Returns edited articles, revision IDs, timestamps, edit summaries, and page sizes.

tools.name: get_category_members
tools.description: Get the pages that belong to a specific Wikipedia category. Returns article titles. The category name should include the "Category:" prefix (e.g., "Category:Programming languages").

tools.name: get_page_views
tools.description: Get the daily page view counts for a Wikipedia article over a date range. Uses the Wikimedia REST API. Dates must be in YYYYMMDD format. Maximum range is 365 days.

tools.name: get_featured_content
tools.description: Get Wikipedia's featured content for a specific date: Today's Featured Article, most-read articles, and On This Day events. Uses the Wikimedia REST API.
